Managing sources

One feed

The gear on a shelf row (shown by Select several or a long press), or the gear beside the source's name in an open article, opens that feed:

Check nowFetch this feed
Summarize this feedEverything of its waiting for one
Mark all readEverything of its
UpdateWhether checks include it
SummarizeWhether checks summarize it
SyncWhether its articles travel to your other devices
Group, Summary languageWhere it sits in the shelf, and its own summary language
Read articles againRe-fetch text that failed
Summarize againDiscard its summaries and redo them
RemoveAsks first, and says what it costs

Summarize again is what to use after changing the summary language or the model — an article that already has a summary is never redone otherwise.

Many feeds

Configuration › Basic › Sources › Sources is the same controls over the whole list, with a filter and a tick box, so "every YouTube channel I imported last week" is one action rather than three hundred.
